collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: Two villagers stack firewood into a perfectly neat pile.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two villagers stack firewood into a perfectly neat pile. They step back and admire it as if it were a carving.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two villagers stack firewood into a perfectly neat pile. A goat climbs on top, and the pile is no longer quite so neat.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two villagers stack firewood into a perfectly neat pile. They argue cheerfully over the best way to stack the smaller pieces.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two villagers stack firewood into a perfectly neat pile. That evening, the woodpile keeps the fire burning long into the night.
